ingredientSections.heading: Pork Butt
items: 2.5-4.5kg pork butt or shoulder (leftovers can be frozen)
750ml Steamworks Oatmeal Stout or similar dark beer

methodSections.heading: Pulled Pork Rub
steps: Measure all ingredients into a small bowl and mix well.

methodSections.heading: Coleslaw Dressing
steps: Measure all ingredients into a bowl and mix well.

methodSections.heading: Coleslaw
steps: Grate or julienne the carrots, shred the cabbages and finely slice the onion.
Mix a liberal dollop of Coleslaw Dressing to taste.

methodSections.heading: Pork Butt
steps: Liberally coat entire pork butt with the rub.
Place in a roasting pan or dish and pour in the stout or dark beer until it is roughly 2cm deep.
Cover pan or dish with aluminium foil or a lid and cook in the oven overnight, or at least 8 hours, at 110°C (225°F).
Let the pork cool and then drain and discard the liquid.
Shred the pork by hand with two forks discarding any excess fat.
Store in a sealed container in the fridge until ready to serve.

methodSections.heading: To Serve
steps: Using a ladle, portion the pork into a bowl, one ladle being roughly equal to a standard bun portion. Mix with a liberal amount of your favourite BBQ sauce to taste.
Ladle the pork in serving portion piles on a baking sheet or tray. Top with slices of aged cheddar and bake at 180°C (350°F) until hot in the middle.
Cut and butter the buns, and toast in a frying pan. Add mayonnaise to the top and bottom bun. Using a spatula, slide the hot pork onto the bottom bun. Top with coleslaw and then the top bun.
